item.author: @tldraw
item.description:
What angle should the selection box be when every shape is rotated differently?

No single angle makes sense, so tldraw falls back to a plain axis-aligned box.

It’s a small edge case, but we thought about it a lot when deciding how to build our bounding boxes.

item.author: @shadcn
item.description:
I'm not against touchscreens on laptop. I can see how they'd be useful.

But In a world where we are touching the keyboard less and buttons are being removed from interfaces, the time for this Macbook has passed.

I could be wrong. I don't think I am.
